channel.title: Gatling on Aby George
channel.description: Recent content in Gatling on Aby George

item.title: Scaling Up: Distributed Load Generation and Long-Term Test Maintenance
item.description: What to do when a single Gatling instance cannot generate enough load, and how to keep a Gatling and Java performance testing framework healthy over time.

item.title: Running Gatling in CI/CD: Pipelines and Environment Configuration
item.description: Wiring a Gatling and Maven project into a GitHub Actions pipeline, with clean environment configuration for dev, staging, and production targets.

item.title: Reading Gatling Reports: Percentiles, Throughput, and What Actually Matters
item.description: A practical guide to Gatling's HTML report, covering the global stats page, response time distribution, and how to actually find a problem in the details.

item.title: Setting Performance SLAs With Gatling Assertions
item.description: Using Gatling's global and per-request assertions to turn subjective load test results into an objective pass or fail build.

item.title: Load, Stress, Soak, and Spike Testing: Choosing the Right Injection Strategy
item.description: The difference between load, stress, soak, and spike testing, and how to configure each type of performance test in Gatling.

item.title: Modeling Realistic User Journeys: Pacing, Think Time, and Scenario Design
item.description: Designing Gatling scenarios that mimic real user behavior, using pause, think time randomization, and weighted user paths.

item.title: Checks and Validations: Making Sure Your Load Test Catches Real Failures
item.description: Going beyond status code checks in Gatling, with response body validation, header checks, and why a fast response is not the same as a correct one.

item.title: Correlation and Authentication: Extracting Tokens and Handling Login Flows
item.description: Extracting session tokens and other dynamic values from Gatling responses with check, and reusing them across an authenticated scenario.

item.title: Feeders 101: Driving Tests With CSV, JSON, and In-Memory Data
item.description: Using Gatling feeders to parameterize load tests with CSV, JSON, and custom Java data sources, without every virtual user hitting the exact same data.

item.title: Scenarios and Virtual Users: Understanding Injection Profiles
item.description: A guide to Gatling's injection profiles, from atOnceUsers and rampUsers to constantUsersPerSec and staged load patterns.

item.title: Your First Real Simulation: The Gatling Java DSL Explained
item.description: A practical walkthrough of Gatling's Java DSL, covering exec, chaining, HTTP protocol configuration, and separating scenarios from simulations.

item.title: Getting Started: Setting Up a Gatling and Java Project From Scratch
item.description: How to set up a Gatling performance testing project with Java and Maven, from an empty folder to your first passing build.
